raw_text: The Indian Navy on Saturday issued a strong denial regarding a synthetic video circulating on social media that purported to show one of its frigates sinking in the Arabian Sea. A Navy spokesperson confirmed all vessels are accounted for and operational. Digital forensics experts identified the footage as AI-generated, with warship imagery composited onto stock ocean footage. The video originated from Pakistani social media accounts and was amplified by Urdu-language news outlets.
clean_text: Indian Navy denied synthetic video showing frigate sinking. All vessels confirmed operational. Forensics identified AI-generated footage composited onto stock ocean imagery.
